mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and remains above this level for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that dampens economic growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has been above 4.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate and decline in non-farm payrolls indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which signals an impending economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion phase characterized by high consumer spending and housing starts, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as valuations become stretched, leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion by HOUST and RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past 3 months indicates robust supply chain conditions and strong economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has increased for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has been above 4.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which signals an imminent economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both decline in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 8.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 8.0%.
